validation_failed.message: Some details need to be corrected before we can accept this.
validation_failed.next: Check the details, correct what is wrong and send again.

unauthenticated.message: You need to sign in to continue.
unauthenticated.next: Sign in and we will bring you back to this page.

step_up_required.message: For this step we need to confirm it is you.
step_up_required.next: Confirm it is you, then repeat the step; nothing has changed yet.

forbidden.message: You do not have permission to do this, so nothing was changed.
forbidden.next: Ask the person who manages it to give you access.

butler_approval_required.message: Butler did not take this step. An authorized staff member must do it manually.
butler_approval_required.next: Review the details and use the manual action, or ask an authorized staff member.

not_found.message: We could not find this, or it is not shared with you.
not_found.next: Check the link, or ask the person who sent it to share it again.

cross_origin_request.message: For your safety, we did not accept this because it was sent from another page.
cross_origin_request.next: Open this page again on our website and send it from there.

version_conflict.message: Someone changed this while you were working, so your change was not saved.
version_conflict.next: Open the latest version, check what changed, then make your change again if it is still needed.

idempotency_key_reused.message: This request repeats an earlier attempt with different details, so we did not carry it out.
idempotency_key_reused.next: Reload the page to check the current state, then start again if the change is still needed.

operation_pending.message: We are still working on your earlier request, and it is not confirmed yet.
operation_pending.next: Wait a moment and reload this page to see the result; do not send it again.

outcome_unknown.message: We could not confirm whether this went through.
outcome_unknown.next: Reload this page and check whether the change is there before you try again.

approval_stale.message: This changed after it was approved, so the approval no longer applies.
approval_stale.next: Review the current version and approve it again, or ask the person who approves it.

publication_ineligible.message: This listing cannot be published yet because some approvals are missing.
publication_ineligible.next: Open the publishing checklist to see what is missing and who can approve it.

listing_unavailable.message: This property is not available at the moment.
listing_unavailable.next: Browse similar properties, or ask us about this one.

transition_denied.message: This step is not possible right now, so nothing was changed.
transition_denied.next: Reload the page to see where things stand now.

link_invalid.message: This sign-in link does not work.

link_expired.message: This sign-in link has expired; these links work only for a short time.
link_expired.next: Request a new link and open it soon after it arrives.

link_consumed.message: This sign-in link has already been used.
link_consumed.next: If you are not signed in, request a new link.

link_revoked.message: This sign-in link has been cancelled and no longer works.

invitation_expired.next: Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

invitation_used.message: This invitation has already been answered.
invitation_used.next: Sign in to see what you have access to.

invitation_revoked.message: This invitation is no longer valid; a newer one may have replaced it.
invitation_revoked.next: Use the newest invitation in your email, or ask the person who invited you.

passkey_failed.message: We could not confirm your passkey.
passkey_failed.next: Try again, or sign in with an email link instead.

rate_limited.message: There were too many attempts in a short time, so this one was not carried out.
rate_limited.next: Wait a little, then try again.
rate_limited.nextTimed: Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

unavailable.message: Part of our service is not working right now, so nothing was saved.
unavailable.next: Try again in a few minutes; if it is urgent, call us on +359879696870.

internal_error.message: Something went wrong on our side, and we cannot confirm whether your change was saved.
internal_error.next: Reload the page and check before you try again.
